identity: A single ḥadīth from Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Kitāb al-Īmān — the Prophet's dream of the people shown to him wearing shirts of differing lengths, with ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb's trailing on the ground, interpreted as الدين. Isnād: محمد بن عبيد الله ← إبراهيم بن سعد ← صالح ← ابن شهاب ← أبو أمامة بن سهل ← أبو سعيد الخدري. No <NL> anywhere: 67 tokens in one unbroken line.
law: §D. Two rules do everything here. D1 as revised in batch 2: cut an isnād link ONLY at an explicit قال + direct transmission verb (قال حدثنا / قال أخبرنا); a chain strung on عن … عن … أنه سمع is one syntactic sentence with no internal stop and welds entire. G1 as WIDENED in batch 15: an attribution swallows its whole report — the boundary goes in front of the attribution and nowhere after it until the next speaker takes a turn. Result: 4 segments over 67 tokens.
